links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid readability (ease and grade level) of AI-generated patient education guides
links.effect: Flesch reading ease was 41.75 for Gemini vs 34.10 for ChatGPT (p = 0.080, not significant); grade level did not differ significantly between tools. Authors judged readability adequate.
links.quote: Although Google Gemini had a higher ease score (41.75) compared to ChatGPT (34.10), this difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.080).

screen.reason: Evaluates and compares the readability, reliability (modified DISCERN), and length of patient education materials generated by ChatGPT vs. Google Gemini without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
